dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, how was your volleyball game on Friday?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ wʌz jʊr ˈvɑːlibɔːl ˌɡeɪm ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It was great! Our team won!
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈɡreɪt! aʊər ˈtiːm ˈwʌn!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Well done! What was the score?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl ˈdʌn! ˈwʌt wʌz ðə ˈskɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Three to one. We beat the engineering team.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː tə ˈwʌn. wiː ˈbiːt ði ˌɛndʒɪˈnɪrɪŋ ˌtiːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Last year, they won every game.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, ðeɪ ˈwʌn ˈɛvri ˈɡeɪm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Did you win last time, too?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈwɪn ˈlæst ˈtaɪm, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, we lost. But this time, we played better!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, wiː ˈlɔːst. bʌt ðɪs ˈtaɪm, wiː ˈpleɪd ˈbɛtər!
